headline: Ford, Applied Digital, U Power, Block And Alphabet: Why These 5 Stocks Are On Investors
summary: The Dow rose 2.85% to 47,909.92, the S&P 500 climbed 2.5% to 6,782.81 and the Nasdaq advanced 2.8% to 22,634.99 after a two-week ceasefire was declared.
why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is the main benchmark for US equity market performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index rose 2.5% after the ceasefire announcement eased fears of wider conflict.
